Multi-Model Bayesian Optimization for Simulation-Based Design

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
Siyu Tao, Anton van Beek, Daniel W. Apley, Wei Chen Journal of Mechanical Design 2021-04-01 10.1115/1.4050738
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Northwestern University, Evanston, IL 60208
通讯: Siyu Tao @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Northwestern University, Evanston, IL 60208
相关性: 该论文提出的多模型贝叶斯优化方法可显著提高昂贵仿真模型的采样效率，并处理约束和多耦合问题，对植入物/生物力学设计中的多学科优化具有直接借鉴意义。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, and lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context.
动机· 提高多组件昂贵仿真系统的全局优化效率，降低模型评估成本。
方法· 提出多模型贝叶斯优化，动态选择组件模型评估，基于不确定性量化和知识梯度。
结果· 在解析问题和电子封装系统设计中验证了优于传统单模型BO的效率。
验证· 通过两个解析问题和电子封装系统设计案例验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the efficiency of global optimization for engineering systems composed of multiple expensive simulation models by reducing the number of model evaluations.
Method· A multi-model Bayesian optimization approach is proposed that dynamically selects which component model to evaluate per iteration based on uncertainty quantification of linked emulators and the knowledge gradient acquisition function.
Result· The proposed method demonstrates superior efficiency over traditional single-model BO on two analytical problems and a multidisciplinary electronic packaging design optimization.
Validation· Validation is performed through two analytical benchmark problems and a simulation case of an electronic packaging system.
Bayesian optimization · 贝叶斯优化multi-model · 多模型surrogate modeling · 代理建模uncertainty quantification · 不确定性量化knowledge gradient · 知识梯度constraint handling · 约束处理simulation-based design · 基于仿真的设计electronic packaging · 电子封装
Bayesian optimization multi-model surrogate modeling constraint handling simulation-based design

Effect of stem position and length on bone-stem constructs after cementless hip arthroplasty

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now simulation_case
Dae-Kyung Kwak, Sun-Hee Bang, Sung‐Jae Lee, Ji-Hun Park, Je‐Hyun Yoo Bone and Joint Research 2021-04-01 10.1302/2046-3758.104.bjr-2020-0043.r3
单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Hallym University Sacred Heart Hospital, Anyang, South Korea
通讯: Dae-Kyung Kwak @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Hallym University Sacred Heart Hospital, Anyang, South Korea
相关性: 该论文直接研究了股骨柄长度和位置对骨-柄界面的应力和微动的影响，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include patient-specific geometry or population-based analysis, nor does it compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 探究股骨柄长度和位置对骨-柄界面应力和微动的影响
方法· 构建12个股骨有限元模型，模拟不同柄长和位置在步行和爬楼梯条件下的应力与微动
结果· 短柄和内翻位植入导致应力集中和微动增加，爬楼梯条件比步行更显著
验证· 有限元模拟，未进行实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effect of femoral stem length and positioning on cortical bone stress and bone-stem micromotion in cementless hip arthroplasty.
Method· Twelve finite element models of the femur were constructed with three stem lengths and two positions (neutral and varus), simulating press-fit fixation under walking and stair-climbing loads.
Result· Shorter stems and varus insertion increased stress concentration at the medial and lateral interfaces, and micromotions were larger under stair-climbing compared to walking.
Validation· The study is purely computational with no experimental validation.

Osteoconductivity of bioactive Ti-6Al-4V implants with lattice-shaped interconnected large pores fabricated by electron beam melting.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Mikinobu Goto, Akihiko Matsumine, Seiji Yamaguchi, Hiroyuki Takahashi, Koji Akeda et al. Journal of biomaterials applications 2021-04-01 10.1177/0885328220968218
单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Mie University Graduate School of Medicine, Tsu, Japan.
通讯: Akihiro Sudo @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Mie University Graduate School of Medicine, Tsu, Japan. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接相关，涉及多孔钛合金植入物的增材制造、刚度匹配、表面处理和体内骨整合验证。
边界: No fatigue testing; only static compression and push-out tests, no long-term cyclic loading evaluation.
动机· 开发易于去除粉末的多孔钛植入物，实现骨整合。
方法· 采用电子束熔融制造Ti-6Al-4V多孔植入物，并进行ACaHW表面处理。
结果· 植入物杨氏模量与骨匹配，体内显示良好骨结合和固定强度。
验证· 模拟体液浸泡、兔股骨植入及推出测试。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop porous titanium implants with large interconnected pores that facilitate powder removal and promote osseointegration.
Method· Ti-6Al-4V implants with lattice pores were fabricated by electron beam melting and treated with NaOH, CaCl2, heat, and water (ACaHW) to enhance bioactivity.
Result· The implants exhibited a compressive strength of 78.9 MPa and Young's modulus of 3.57 GPa, matching cortical bone, with direct bone bonding and significantly higher fixation strength in vivo.
Validation· In vitro apatite formation in SBF and in vivo rabbit femoral implantation with push-out mechanical testing.

相关性: 该论文直接评估了增材制造钛合金陀螺支架在临界尺寸骨缺损修复中的体内效果，但没有涉及应力遮挡、疲劳性能或表面粗糙度分析。

方法· 在大鼠股骨缺损模型中植入空载或载BMP-2的陀螺片支架
结果· 空载支架恢复38%扭转强度和54%刚度，载BMP-2支架超过完整对侧对照

Motivation· To evaluate the in vivo performance of additively manufactured titanium gyroid-sheet scaffolds for repairing critically sized femoral defects.
Method· Rat femoral segmental defect model was treated with empty or BMP-2-loaded gyroid scaffolds fabricated by additive manufacturing.
Result· Empty scaffolds restored up to 38% torsional strength and 54% stiffness; BMP-2 scaffolds exceeded intact contralateral controls.
Validation· In vivo rat femoral defect model with mechanical torsion testing.

动机· 利用Voronoi镶嵌设计仿生各向异性多孔支架以减少应力遮挡

Motivation· To design porous scaffolds that mimic trabecular bone anisotropy and reduce stress shielding.
Method· Selective Voronoi tessellation with preferential seeding creates anisotropic strut architecture.

单位: Director, Novosibirsk Scientific Research Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics named after Ya.L. Tsivyan of the Ministry of Health of the Russian Federation, 17 Frunze St., Novosibirsk, 630091, R
通讯: Ya. S. Novikova @ Junior Researcher, Scientific Research Department, Novosibirsk Scientific Research Institute of Traumatology and Orthope
相关性: 该论文研究了3D打印多孔钛植入体的骨整合，但未涉及应力遮挡或机械性能，与用户对疲劳和刚度匹配的关注点关联较弱。
边界: This paper does not include any mechanical testing (e.g., compression, fatigue) or analysis of stress shielding/stiffness matching; it focuses solely on biological osseointegration.
动机· 研究孔隙大小与涂层对3D打印钛植入体骨整合的影响。
方法· 在动物体内植入不同孔径和涂层的钛样品，用SEM和组织学分析评估。

Motivation· To investigate the effects of pore size and bioactive coating on osseointegration of 3D-printed titanium implants.
Method· Implants with different pore diameters (100, 200, 400 μm) and calcium phosphate coating were implanted in animals and analyzed via SEM and histology at 90 and 180 days.
Result· Implants with 400 μm pore diameter showed superior osseointegration, and calcium phosphate coating further enhanced bone formation in that group.
Validation· Validation was performed using an in vivo animal model with histological and SEM evaluation.

Motivation· To investigate the deformation and fracture mechanisms of TiC-reinforced TC4 matrix composites fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· TiC/TC4 composites with varying TiC contents were produced via SLM and characterized by microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.
Result· TiC reinforcement significantly increased strength but reduced ductility, with fracture mechanism transitioning from ductile dimple to cleavage fracture.
Validation· Validation was performed through SEM fractography and mechanical property measurements.

方法· 基于腰椎CT扫描设计9种支架，通过有限元分析评估弹性模量，并用FDM打印ABS支架进行实验验证

Motivation· To design 3D scaffold structures with mechanical properties matching bone tissue to mitigate stress shielding.
Method· Nine scaffold designs were created from a lumbar vertebra CT model, evaluated via FEA for effective Young's modulus, and seven were fabricated by FDM using ABS for experimental compression testing.
Result· Periodic porous structures can be tuned to achieve mechanical properties comparable to trabecular bone.
Validation· Experimental compression tests on FDM-printed ABS scaffolds validated the numerical Young's modulus predictions.

Sample-efficient Gear-ratio Optimization for Biomechanical Energy Harvester

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project in_vitro Exp. validation
Taisuke Kobayashi, Yutaro Ikawa, Takamitsu Matsubara arXiv preprint 2021-04-01 10.1007/s41315-021-00170-7
相关性: 本文的贝叶斯优化方法可迁移到植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，但未涉及有限元分析或约束处理。
边界: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for PDEs, implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or constraint handling; it focuses on gear-ratio optimization for energy harvesters via multi-task Bayesian optimization.
动机· 针对多任务下齿轮比优化采样成本高的问题，提出样本高效方法。
方法· 利用多任务贝叶斯优化重用相似任务的结果，加速优化。
结果· 优化速度比随机搜索快约50%，仅需约20分钟。
验证· 通过人体运动能量收集实验验证优化效果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce the high sampling cost of optimizing gear ratios in a CVT-equipped biomechanical energy harvester across multiple tasks.
Method· A multi-task Bayesian optimization framework that reuses optimization results from similar tasks by exploiting task similarities.
Result· The proposed approach achieves optimal gear ratios approximately 50% faster than random search, requiring only about 20 minutes per task.
Validation· Experimental validation on human motion tasks demonstrating sample-efficiency and acceleration via task similarity exploitation.

Motivation· To overcome plant-model mismatch in real-time optimization of uncertain processes by integrating Bayesian optimization and derivative-free optimization concepts.

Motivation· To evaluate early radiographic osseointegration of additively manufactured porous titanium metaphyseal components in revision knee arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective review of 22 patients from two institutions, with immediate postoperative and final follow-up radiographs analyzed by two reviewers using the Knee Society Radiographic Evaluation and Scoring System.
Result· Porous titanium components showed excellent osseointegration with no early clinical failures, and partial or complete bone contact on immediate postoperative radiographs predicted osseointegration.

边界: This paper focuses on dental implant primary stability in ex vivo bone blocks, not on hip implant stress shielding, micromotion, or femoral stem biomechanics.
动机· 探究牙科植入物顶端几何形状对初级稳定性的影响。
方法· 在猪骨块中比较两种顶端形状植入物的插入扭矩、ISQ和推出力。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether modifying the apical geometry of dental implants affects primary stability.
Method· Ex vivo comparison of two implant designs (J-line with apical threads vs. K-line flat tip) in porcine bone blocks, measuring insertion torque, Periotest, ISQ, and push-out force.
Result· Implants with apical threads and longer length showed significantly higher primary stability, especially in soft bone with undersized drilling.
Validation· Ex vivo mechanical testing on porcine bone blocks.
